notes: Author a reproducible-archive packer: sort members by raw UTF-8 bytes (never locale collation) and normalize all owner/group identity out of the archive (uid/gid 0, uname/gname empty, mtime 0, fixed modes, ustar format) so identical input trees yield byte-identical tar output and a stable sha256 identity digest. Medium floor: deliverable is a runnable packer (/app/pack.py) plus the two artifacts from the shipped tree (/app/bundle.tar, /app/bundle.sha256); the verifier executes the packer on hidden trees whose names break locale collation (uppercase-before-lowercase, non-ASCII UTF-8), with empty files/dirs and deep nesting, and byte-compares archives and digests. Nonzero rubric for adversarial_inputs (collation traps), hidden_case_generalization (two distinct hidden trees), and quantitative_correctness (exact byte equality).
